endorsements.name: Fabius Watson
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Automotive 2024 - Day One Results
endorsements.description: Chris Anastasio and Fabius Watson of Team Cluck successfully attacked the ChargePoint Home Flex. However, the bug they used was previously known. They still earn $16,000 and 3 Master of Pwn Points.
endorsements.subtitle: Pwn2Own 2024

povs.explanation: Pwn2Own validates successful exploitation through live competition and independent expert verification.
